title: Saudi Arabian Naan with Vibrant Cheese
description: A fusion of Saudi Arabian and Indian flavors, these vibrant naan breads are topped with a blend of vibrant cheese.
instructions: 1. Combine flour, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
2. Gradually add in the Arabian water and mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for about 10 minutes until smooth.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a cloth, and let it rest for 1 hour.
5. Preheat a non-stick skillet or grill over medium heat.
6. Divide the dough into 6-8 equal portions.
7. Roll each portion into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
8. Place the dough disks in the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
9. Brush the cooked naan with a little water and sprinkle with vibrant cheese.
10. Serve warm with your favorite accompaniments.
